scope: ONLY physical column presence in committed Drizzle snapshot; does NOT claim migrations replayed or any runtime semantic parity.
rules: Single-column presence is not field semantic parity; no approved target field can be declared verified by this report.
Staged fields do not exist in the committed snapshot until Chat 1 registers generated migrations.
No target proposed does not equal missing feature; determine provider-managed, feature-owned typed schema or approved retirement.
Normalization expressions require role/tenant/temporal field-by-field proof and executed negative tests.
Recompute on every snapshot or triage-ledger change; do not carry stale evidence to final database gate.
